title: cymbachne angustata var. chinensis
intro: Cymbachne angustata var. chinensis, commonly known as Chinese Cyperus or Cyperus chinensis, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and fever, and has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cymbachne angustata var. chinensis include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
